pages.raw_meta: Ashland Global Holdings Inc. (NYSE: ASH) is a premier specialty materials company with a conscious and proactive mindset for sustainability. The company serves customers in a wide range of consumer and industrial markets, including adhesives, architectural coatings, automotive, construction, energy, food and beverage, nutraceuticals, personal care and pharmaceutical.
raw_blocks: New Central R&D EMEA lab opening and customer event in The Netherlands
Ashland solvers unveiled new R&D laboratories with an innovation seminar for customers in Zwijndrecht.

Ashland recently hosted an Innovation Day for analysts and investors at the company’s Bridgewater, New Jersey facility showcasing the enhanced capabilities and expanded applications of Ashland's scalable technology platforms.
Are you a passionate, tenacious, solver? Then we’d like to meet you and bet you’d like to meet us.
Ashland has completed an expansion of its pharmaceutical manufacturing plant in Cabreúva, Brazil
Celebrating second expansion of manufacturing and R&D lab in Mullingar, Ireland
Ashland has completed the second expansion of its pharmaceutical injectables manufacturing and R&D lab in Mullingar, Ireland.
open innovation – solving with Ashland
We welcome partnerships with industry leaders, academic institutions, and emerging start-ups. Together, we can share innovative ideas and work towards responsibly solving for a better world.
who transforms vegetable oils? we do. Ashland vegetable oils offer attractive characteristics with 4-in-1 benefits, which include dispersant, film forming, binding and delivery system.
who has biodegradable, sustainably sourced biopolymers? we do. Ashland is expanding its tool box of cellulose derivatives and applying a similar approach to other biopolymers.
Ashland has launched exciting, new technology platforms aligned to our core that extend to secondary markets with new and differentiated capabilities.
read more > view video >
who is super at wetting? we are. Our super wetting agents are super performers, delivering optimal coverage while being environmentally safe.
who achieves superior performance with multifunctional starch? we do Ashland modified starches aim to enhance the natural benefits of starch with new performance capabilities..
who puts the control in your release profile? we do. Viatel™ platform of bioresorbable polymers are used in parenteral controlled release and medical device formulations.
who has superior additives for high-value markets? we do. This high efficiency / low VOC platform offers improved sustainability, and 100 percent yield with no waste.
who helps optimize your traditional manufacturing processes? we do. Ashland is building on its natrosol™ rheology modifier technology by developing a liquid additive concept.
Ashland's employees are solvers who are passionate about creating technologies and solutions to improve our customers' product and process, and reduce our environmental impact.
We consider sustainability a journey, not a destination, and we continue to make progress.
